globalFindings.summary: Research pack prepared against PickMe card-catalogue version 2.16 as observed on main on 2026-08-31. The pack is research-only and does not modify canonical contract or synchronized resource bytes.

A generic accountYear period is not semantically equivalent to a rolling 48-month reimbursement. TD NEXUS terms start a 48-month period when the first qualifying fee posts; CIBC describes one credit every four years without an account-anniversary reset. These benefits need an intervalMonths=48 representation rather than accountYear.

American Express Canada NEXUS credits use issuer-defined four-year eligibility periods tied to legacy-cohort dates or card anniversary rules. Do not normalize those to the same rolling model used for TD merely because both are described as every four years.
Store the value of each reset window, not the advertised annual total. Example: U.S. Gold Dining Credit is $10 per calendar month, not a $120 calendar-year credit.

The current U.S. Platinum and Sapphire Reserve issuer pages materially differ from the contract snapshot: current annual fees and recurring-credit stacks have changed. U.S. Platinum's Saks benefit ended effective 2026-07-01.
CIBC increased the NEXUS rebate on eligible premium cards from C$100 to C$200 effective 2025-07-01. Historical C$100 materials should not override current product pages/benefit guides.

Welcome offers, targeted Amex/Chase offers, points bonuses, free-night awards, lounge passes, insurance, and non-guaranteed promotional offers were excluded. Time-limited cardmember account credits were retained only where the issuer's current product page states them as standard benefits available to eligible cardmembers through a defined end date.
No MCC was added merely because an issuer named a merchant or category. Credit-level MCC arrays remain empty unless the issuer material itself published an MCC relevant to the credit.

Card variants and legacy products must remain separate. Citi Custom Cash is published in the catalogue but marked withdrawn/effectiveTo 2026-08-31. Venture X is currently a draft candidate and is audited separately from Venture, VentureOne, and business variants because the user explicitly requested the Venture X risk audit.

refusals.reason: Public issuer pages are not assumed exhaustive. A card remains partial or unknown where official materials are ambiguous, fragmented, login-gated, or do not prove that all standard recurring monetary credits have been enumerated.
The contract's Spotify and Netflix rebate rows are inferred and lacked issuer citation. They were not promoted to issuer-verified facts in this pack.
The issuer describes its trusted-traveler benefit as Reward Points rather than a monetary statement/portal/account credit or reimbursement; points bonuses are outside this pack's requested scope.

Skip+/monthly voucher and Disney+ promotional partner offers were not normalized because issuer terms characterize them as offers/promotions that may change or end rather than durable standard cardholder monetary credits.
Targeted or Amex Offers-style promotions, including venue/merchant offers not guaranteed as a permanent standard credit to every eligible cardmember, were excluded.
The Canadian Walmart Rewards cards express the annual Walmart+ credit as a percentage of the current regular-priced annual plan, including taxes. A fixed CAD amount was refused rather than invented.
